title: Safecast Reading Counts per Minute Leaderboard
dataSources: Seismograph (`seismo:reading`), Geiger counter (`geiger:cpm`), lightning strikes (`lightning:strike`), radon (`radon:reading`), all-sky meteor camera (`allsky:capture`), river-level gauge (`riverlevel:reading`), magnetometer (`magnetometer:reading`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`).
app: DIY citizen-science sensors — Raspberry Shake seismograph, Geiger counter, AS3935/Blitzortung lightning detector, radon monitor, all-sky meteor camera, river-level gauge, and magnetometer — via MQTT and scripted inputs to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=safecast:reading cpm=*
| stats sum(cpm) as total_value, avg(cpm) as avg_value by device_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average counts per minute across Safecast reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `cpm` values for each Safecast reading event and review total and average counts per minute by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total counts per minute.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews which device shows the biggest counts per minute numbers in your Safecast reading data.
